policy: World Anvil facts constrain these original proposals. New names, layouts and placements are not canon. Existing routes and confirmed pins remain unchanged.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Elven-founded, multi-species scholarship; archives and credentials. Magic and engineering facilities require separation.
briefs.visualDirection: Weathered institutional stone with later brick and electrical additions. Ivory, oxidized green, dusty violet. A campus embedded in a lived city, not one cathedral. Separate magical laboratories from electrical engineering across open courts; no shared machinery or magical power grid.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Redevelopment, affluent professionals and glass towers; the Soft Border faces Low Halo to the south.
briefs.visualDirection: Rain-streaked glass, concrete towers and retro electronic media screens, maintained shopfronts, half-finished redevelopment, modest legacy buildings between expensive apartments. Cool cyan, white, pink advertisements. Shining Spire is a corporate glass high-rise, not a glowing magical cathedral. Surface trams only; no elevated metro.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Civic administration and contested public authority.
briefs.visualDirection: A patched twentieth-century civic complex, concrete annexes against older stone, queues, terminals and paper signage. Faded cream, oxidized teal, orange civic accents. Several independent agencies; no imperial palace or unified police command. Place offices as proposed branches, not asserted headquarters.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Northeastern industry under Crownline infrastructure leverage.
briefs.visualDirection: Utility campus and harsh industrial blocks, white-and-gold corporate signage over soot, cables, pumps and service vans. Dirty concrete, sulfur yellow, cold white. Crownline utility and compliance functions; Bastion contractors distinct. Functional diagram of utility service roads, not magical generators.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Northwestern monastery; old religious obligations remain ambiguous.
briefs.visualDirection: Three visually dominant old spires above layered cloisters and neighborhood walls, weathered stone and patched practical services, muted plum, old copper, candlelight. No invented deity, pantheon, holy relic or confirmed supernatural engine. Religious spaces are deliberately non-specific.

landmarks.name: The Unnamed Court
landmarks.note: No public account of its rites

briefs.establishedAnchor: Western elven district; maintained gardens and separated utility systems support its comfort.
briefs.visualDirection: Tall narrow pale-brick and stone homes, mature trees, shaded courtyards, functioning cisterns, hidden technical utilities; magical facilities physically separate. Sage green, cream, plum flowers. Maintained but aged and disputed, not a fantasy tree kingdom. Include service staff and ordinary households.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Commerce, public authority and surface transit.
briefs.visualDirection: Dense worn commercial center, mixed-era offices, civic counters, busy street-running tram interchange, street vendors and freight access. Slate, faded red, amber and dirty daylight. No subway, metro entrances or flawless grand planned symmetry.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Industrial waterway connecting waterfront, belt and harbor.
briefs.visualDirection: Broad dirty canal-and-river system with working quays, pump houses, bridge piers, barges and runoff. Petrol green, rust red, polluted brown, practical amber. Show travel along water and towpaths, no pristine blue leisure canal. Meridian-marked freight handling and Crownline-adjacent water assets.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Eastern working waterfront; construction and dismantling coexist.
briefs.visualDirection: Huge partially built and dismantled hulls, cranes, sheds, repair docks and worker lanes. Rust orange, ship-primer red, oily green water. Modern-industrial fantasy waterfront, not medieval sailing port; welding and mechanical equipment, no magitech.

landmarks.name: Breakers Gate
landmarks.note: Parts leave; whole ships rarely do

briefs.establishedAnchor: Low Halo southern repair corridor; goblin-majority, mixed-species trade.
briefs.visualDirection: Cramped southern Low Halo mechanic bays, salvaged brick sheds, homes above shops, electrical conduits and improvised repair crews. Oil black, hazard orange, acid green graffiti. Repair rather than monumental foundries. Narrow parts lane; no fabricated formal clan subdivisions.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Buried streets and structures beneath Low Halo and Central Core.
briefs.visualDirection: Underground cutaway of multiple buried cities: ceilings of newer foundations, old roads cut off by columns, half-collapsed houses and utility tunnels through former rooms. Ochre dust, black cavities, weak amber worklights. No open sky, surface historic quarter, subway or commuter railway; map uncertainty and collapse.

landmarks.name: The Interrupted Street
landmarks.note: Old road meets a newer wall

briefs.establishedAnchor: Neglected southern settlement beyond the industrial belt.
briefs.visualDirection: Dense working homes below smoke-heavy city edge, patched roofs, shared courtyards, shops, practical community services and worn roads. Clay red, laundry colors, faded blue and warm windows. Show inhabited dignity, not abandoned emptiness or a caricature of poverty.

landmarks.name: Neighbors Gate
landmarks.note: Local watch; ask who knows you

briefs.establishedAnchor: Southeastern salvage terrain; Patchkin goblin work.
briefs.visualDirection: Scrap terrain with winding safe lanes, dismantled appliances and machinery, sorting sheds and workers homes, patched cranes. Oxidized orange, turquoise enamel, steel grey. Salvage economy, not a generic desert rubbish dump; no magical robot army.

landmarks.name: Meal Tin
landmarks.note: Hot food beside the sorting lanes

briefs.establishedAnchor: Southwestern fringe; Dustwalkers, salvage, hunting and agriculture.
briefs.visualDirection: City seam with real cultivated plots, sheds made of salvage, grazing margins, hunters tracks, rough carts and distant worn city roofs. Dust tan, crop green, faded blue. Practical food production mixed with scrap work, not all barren wasteland. Keep hinterland settlements unnamed.

landmarks.name: The Pickers Line
landmarks.note: Scrap work along the city edge

landmarks.name: Last Fence
landmarks.note: Fields give way to rough country

landmarks.name: Shared Store
landmarks.note: Tools and harvest under patched roofing

briefs.establishedAnchor: Southwestern edge; uncertain authority and survival.
briefs.visualDirection: A rough city fringe meeting unsettled country, broken road verges, modest shelters, patched boundary works and several informal foot crossings. Dust ochre, rust and muted green. No invented national border, foreign kingdom, immigration regime or war front.

landmarks.name: Last Lit Post
landmarks.note: Beyond this, bring your own light

briefs.establishedAnchor: Ashborn goblins, dwarf strongholds, heavy work; BASHRS originates here.
briefs.visualDirection: Immense steelworks, workshop strongholds, dense labor housing, physical freight access, soot and safety notices, shift-changing crowds. Furnace orange, coal black, oxidized blue steel. Orc street power and industrial labor; no magical electrical machinery. Do not place a confirmed BASHRS headquarters.

landmarks.name: Worker Rooms
landmarks.note: Homes within reach of the job

briefs.establishedAnchor: PDA-only identity: repaired community, independence and mutual support.
briefs.visualDirection: Explicitly PROVISIONAL, developed only from existing PDA description. Independent repaired row housing, workshops, communal courtyards, practical shared resources, no monarchy. Worn blue, brick, warm orange, handmade signs. No invented leader, faction history or external adjacency.

landmarks.name: Mending Court
landmarks.note: Shared repair; bring what you can

landmarks.name: The Spare Chair
landmarks.note: Sit; nobody charges by the minute

landmarks.name: Common Gate
landmarks.note: Entry by conversation, not a crown

briefs.establishedAnchor: Far eastern hazard landscape; uninhabitable.
briefs.visualDirection: Expansive dead ash terrain, corroded industrial remnants, dangerous ground and sparse warning markers. Bleached grey, sickly yellow, rust and black. No resident settlement, cafe, camp, harvest, working transit or cheerful explorer base. Show danger and limits, not a complete safe route.

landmarks.name: Corroded Span
landmarks.note: Bridge remnant; do not trust it

briefs.establishedAnchor: Deep southeastern unknown; maps cease to be reliable.
briefs.visualDirection: Very deep underground uncertain cutaway, disconnected remnants, black unknown cavities and collapsed descents. Low ochre worklight, violet-black shadow, pale chalk. Mostly unreadable dark space, not a fully surveyed secret city. No confirmed Nexus, monster lair, civilization, power source, active railway or guaranteed safe passage.

briefs.establishedAnchor: Surface travel and competing maps; no subway.
briefs.visualDirection: Clearly labelled SCHEMATIC ROUTE STUDY, no asserted city-scale geometry or precise adjacency. Worn city street samples linked by a graphic route spine, street-running tram, freight road, foot passage, rooftop path and service access. Muted asphalt grey, orange, cyan and red route coding; no underground rail or invented travel times.

landmarks.name: Unconfirmed Link
landmarks.note: Dashed route; not a travel promise
